---
# Partner edition on OpenShift Virtualization (CNV) - run by partner instructors
__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: "Ansible Lightspeed Coding Lab"
    category: Workshops
    multiuser: true

cloud_provider: openshift_cnv
config: openshift-workloads
ocp4_installer_version: "4.17"
num_users: 25
cnv_cluster_pool: partner-cnv-emea
workloads:
  - agnosticd.core_workloads.ocp4_workload_authentication_htpasswd
  - agnosticd.ansible_workloads.ocp4_workload_ansible_lightspeed
  - agnosticd.ansible_workloads.ocp4_workload_devspaces_vscode
